title: Fortune Auto 350Z (separate style rear)
description: • Chassis Fitment: 2003–2008 Nissan 350Z (Z33) / 2003–2007 Infiniti G35 Coupe & Sedan• Default Spring Rates: 10k Front / 8k Rear• Damping Adjustment: 24-Step Rebound Adjustable Dampers with FA Synthetic Shock Oil• Digressive Technology: Billet High Flow Digressive Pistons for maximum damper sensitivity• Construction: Monotube damper with high-pressure nitrogen gas & T6 6061 bright dip anodized aluminum mounts• Bearings: Radial bearing mounts standard for smooth steering and noise-free operation• Modularity: Fully rebuildable, revalveable, and upgradeable to 2-Way or 3-Way external canister setups• Warranty: 5-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty
